title: Energy bands
back: Conductor: overlap. Insulator: gap > 3 eV. Semiconductor: small gap (Si 1.1 eV, Ge 0.7 eV).

title: p-n junction
back: Diffusion leaves fixed ions: depletion region; field n → p gives the barrier (Si ≈ 0.7 V).

title: Diode I–V characteristic
back: Forward: steep rise after ≈ 0.7 V (mA). Reverse: tiny µA current until breakdown.

title: Half-wave rectifier
back: Diode conducts in one half-cycle only; output frequency = input frequency (50 Hz).

title: Full-wave rectifier
back: D₁ and D₂ conduct in alternate halves, same direction through R_L; output 100 Hz.

title: Electron and hole concentrations
back: Doping raises one carrier and lowers the other.

title: Dynamic resistance
legend: ΔV, ΔI = small changes read from the I–V graph
back: Small in forward bias above the knee; very large in reverse.

title: n-type vs p-type
back: n-type: pentavalent donor (P, As, Sb), electrons majority. p-type: trivalent acceptor (B, Al, Ga, In), holes majority. Both neutral.

title: Depletion layer and bias
back: "Forward mein patla, reverse mein mota": forward bias thins the barrier and depletion layer; reverse bias widens them.
